question.text: Cerium <math'> <mrow> <mtext>(Z</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>=</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>58)</mtext></mrow> is an important member of the lanthanoids. Which of the following statements about cerium is incorrect?</math'>

options.text: The common oxidation states of cerium are +3 and +4
The +3 oxidation state of cerium is more stable than +4 oxidation state
Cerium (III) acts as an oxidising agent
The +4 oxidation state of cerium is known in solution

solution.text:
+4 oxidation state of cerium is also known in solutions.
4f 1 5d 0 6s 0  :  Ce +3
4f 0 5d 0 6s 0  :  Ce +4
The high charge on Ce 4+ leads to high hydration, hydrated Ce 4+ is hydrolysed giving polymeric species and H + . Ce( +4 ) is stable in strongly acidic solutions and used as oxidising agent in volumetric analysis.
